verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at cua.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary and section index, plus a markdown rendition of the docs at cua.ai/docs.md. A second llms.txt index at cua.ai/docs/llms.txt carries many agent-readable section summaries (Driver, Spaces, Volume, streaming, uninstall), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no first-party guidance on how to feed these files to an agent, and no independent or community report of agents actually using them.
